lines.speaker: Harry Potter
lines.text: Your jaw tightens whenever his name surfaces, yet your eyes dart toward the stairs instead of the doors. That contradiction tells me more than any denial you might offer.
lines.expression: head tilted slightly, gaze sweeping from her clenched jaw to the corridor corners

lines.speaker: Draconia Malfoy
lines.text: I learned to mask fear before I mastered my first spell, Potter. The stairs lead to a dormitory where I must pretend tonight never happened, and the doors lead to questions I cannot answer.
lines.expression: shoulders squaring, chin lifting as her eyes flicker between the staircase and his face
